decision.reason: [ev-6e35b4906b1d] supports the change type: cluster names that were accepted before are now validated (max 32 lower-case alphanumeric characters or '-', starting and ending with an alphanumeric character), and it can still be bypassed with upgradeCompatibility <= v1.15. That fits validation-tightened. The subject is the problem: this is a check on a configuration value, not wire or protocol behaviour, so protocol-behavior looks like the wrong family. But neither this excerpt nor the section context, including [ev-b62da9c1ceb5], names the config key or Helm value path that holds the cluster name, so a correct config-key or helm-value subject cannot be built without guessing (P1's 'clusterName' is not in the evidence). I need an artifact or doc that names the cluster-name setting (agent flag/ConfigMap key or Helm values path) to fix the subject identity.
